_comment: In-repo SideStore source. The Action (../.github/workflows/build-sources.yml) runs generate.py on a schedule (and on release), reads THIS repo's latest GitHub release, and commits the refreshed apps-visionos.json next to this file. This port is Apple Vision Pro only, so only the visionOS source carries an app; apps-ios.json is generated empty. The visionOS IPA is the release asset whose name contains 'vision' (dusklight-<ver>-visionOS.ipa).

ios.name: Dusklight — iPhone & iPad
ios.subtitle: Twilight Princess, natively
ios.description: Placeholder iOS source. This port is Apple Vision Pro only — use the visionOS source.

visionos.name: Dusklight — Apple Vision Pro
visionos.subtitle: Twilight Princess in 2D and stereoscopic 3D
visionos.description: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess on Apple Vision Pro — a free-floating 2D window and a world-locked stereoscopic 3D mode. Bring your own GameCube disc.

apps.name: Dusklight
apps.subtitle: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess for Apple Vision Pro
apps.localizedDescription: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess on Apple Vision Pro: the full GameCube game rendered natively on Metal, in a free-floating 2D window and a world-locked stereoscopic 3D mode with foveated rendering, spatial audio anchored to the screen, and live-tunable screen size, distance, and depth. Ships with no game content; you supply your own GameCube Twilight Princess disc image.
